name: Soft Gradient Glass
description: Bright pastel mesh gradients that drift slowly, glassy rounded cards with a frosted fill, a light rim and soft long shadows, floating blurred orbs in two parallax layers, and calm rise-in motion. Rounded heavy type with a gradient accent word. Friendly, premium, app-launch feel. No emoji.
prompt_hint: Write 8-12 short scenes (3-5 s each) that present a product, feature or habit calmly. title.kicker is a small pill label and title.main the headline (max ~26 chars). Use 1-3 elements per scene: card for features, stat for one figure, panels for options (winner index), checklist for steps, timeline, meter (shape gauge or battery) for progress, chart for a simple comparison, icon with a label for a single idea. Never use emoji.
